repository.name: @webex/internal-plugin-feature
repository.purpose: Internal Webex JS SDK plugin that exposes feature toggles as webex.internal.feature. It is a stateless facade over the device plugin's developer, user, and entitlement feature collections: promise-based reads, writes of user and developer toggles to the Feature service (single and bundled), handling of toggle records pushed by Mercury, and re-emission of device collection changes as change:developer, change:entitlement, and change:user events.

public_interfaces.audience: internal-plugin-mercury, internal-plugin-board, internal-plugin-lyra, calling, webex-server, and recipe-private-web-client in the webex-js-sdk workspace
public_interfaces.notes: Importing the package registers Feature as internal plugin 'feature' with config.feature (an empty object). The default export is the Feature class.

public_interfaces.name: webex.internal.feature runtime methods and events
public_interfaces.audience: Mercury, LLM, board, conversation, and presence plugins, and first-party clients
public_interfaces.notes: getFeature rejects for key types other than developer, user, and entitlement; setFeature rejects for anything but developer and user; updateFeature applies only user and developer records; setBundledFeatures mutates its input array.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not keep toggle data on the Feature instance.
negative_guidance.why: The device plugin's feature collections are the single store; a second copy would diverge.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not let setFeature, updateFeature, or setBundledFeatures write the entitlement collection.
negative_guidance.why: Entitlements are server-granted and read-only from this plugin.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not rename updateFeature or change getFeature to return synchronously.
negative_guidance.why: Mercury calls updateFeature by name and callers chain .then on getFeature.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not trust the JSDoc return annotations over the code.
negative_guidance.why: getFeature and setFeature document resolved values or an endpoint response that differ from what the code returns.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not treat README.md as the list of methods.
negative_guidance.why: It lists none and contains a WHATEVER placeholder. See docs/adr/0001-retain-product-readme.md.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not infer a coverage threshold for this package.
negative_guidance.why: The developer confirmed no coverage gate applies; the legacy Jest config disables coverage collection.

high.expectation: Source and unit test evidence both support the change, and the behavior has a case in test/unit/spec/feature.js.

medium.expectation: Only source evidence exists, for example setBundledFeatures, getFeature for a missing key, or updateFeature with a developer record. Pin current behavior with a characterization test before modifying.

low.expectation: Neither source nor tests settle the question. Stop and report the gap.
